questions.explanation:
(A) ; in presence of CO, effective configuration =

Three lone pair of electrons in metal 3d orbitals for back bonding with vacant () pi* orbital of C in CO.

(B) ; in presence of CO, effective configuration =

Four lone pair for back bonding with CO.

(C) ; effective configuration =

Three lone pair for back bonding with CO.

(D) ; effective configuration =

Three lone pair for back bonding with CO.

Since, Vanadium has a negative charge, it is present in lower oxidation state and can easily back donate the electrons from metal orbitals to () pi* orbital of carbonyl ligand. Hence, it forms a much stronger bond with carbon or carbonyl thereby weakening the carbon oxygen bond.
